resources.string: This service helps populate delivery fields from the Uber Driver app.
Open Ranger Profit HUD from the car app dock for the always-on dashboard.
Ready — open Ranger Profit HUD on DHU to see the dashboard.
Allow notifications, then tap a test button.

Split (1/4 or 1/2): On DHU home with Uber map showing, tap Ranger HUD in the dock — do not open it from Recents. Use a wide DHU window (desktop-head-unit -c dhu/wide-split.ini). If it still goes full-screen, your head unit may only allow one app at a time; the truck SYNC layout may differ.
Test stats sent — open Ranger Profit HUD on DHU.
